title: Life without a cell phone – B2 English Listening Test

seo.title: Life without a cell phone – B2 English Listening Test - Test-English
seo.description: English advanced listening test (CEFR B2). Transcription included. Watch a video about technology and answer the questions.

parts:
B2 English Listening Test

Watch a video about two people’s experiences with mobile phones. For questions 1 to 7, choose the correct option.

Questions

questions.prompt: Which reaction do people NOT have when Mathew tells them he does not have a cell phone?

disbelief
envy

not many people live around where he lives
people don’t notice what is going on around them
people don’t go out because they are on their phones all the time
she never feels she’s missing out on things if she’s not on her phone
she really hates being on her phone
if she isn’t online she feels that she is missing out on things

does not want to be in touch with people all the time
